subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should OpenClaw change ordinary direct/source messaging turns from automatic bare-text delivery to explicit message-tool or final-only delivery for tool-interleaved text, and what compatibility path should existing channel setups get?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix changes security-sensitive user-visible delivery defaults and could suppress expected replies for existing users unless maintainers choose an upgrade/config strategy.

options.title: Introduce strict delivery with a compatibility path
options.body: Add a generic final-only or message-tool-only policy with migration/docs and a compatibility-preserving default or opt-out for existing direct-chat users.

options.title: Preserve automatic defaults and harden only obvious leaks
options.body: Keep current automatic delivery semantics while suppressing narrower commentary/reasoning and cron leakage paths, accepting that some inter-tool plain text remains visible by design.

options.title: Flip defaults to explicit-send
options.body: Make direct/source messaging require explicit message-tool or final tags by default, accepting a breaking change for users who rely on automatic bare assistant replies.

recommendation.title: Introduce strict delivery with a compatibility path
recommendation.body: Add a generic final-only or message-tool-only policy with migration/docs and a compatibility-preserving default or opt-out for existing direct-chat users.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent delivery-mode, auto-reply, and cron-delivery history spans the compatibility and user-visible policy surfaces that need a maintainer decision.
